source_post: LinkedIn post supplied by the user
ranking_rule: Highest relevance to Mahmoud Salama's senior technology profile first.

platforms.title: LinkedIn Jobs
platforms.use_case: Senior technology leadership, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, networking and direct employer applications.
platforms.notes: Strongest platform for your profile because senior roles are often promoted through employer pages and professional networks.

platforms.title: Indeed Egypt
platforms.use_case: Technology, data, software, healthcare IT, remote and international employer vacancies.
platforms.notes: Use exact senior-role keywords and verify whether the application is hosted by Indeed or redirects to the employer.

platforms.title: Glassdoor
platforms.use_case: Vacancy search, employer reviews, salary research and interview intelligence.
platforms.notes: Best used alongside an official employer page to validate company reputation, salary and interview expectations.

platforms.title: WUZZUF
platforms.use_case: Egypt and regional technology, management, architecture, data and program-delivery vacancies.
platforms.notes: A major Egypt-focused recruitment platform with regional expansion.

platforms.title: LoopCV
platforms.use_case: Automated job discovery, matching, application tracking and optional auto-application.
platforms.notes: Use strict filters and manual review for senior roles. Avoid uncontrolled high-volume applications that may reduce application quality.

platforms.title: Google Interview Warmup
platforms.use_case: Practice interview answers, review job-related terms and improve verbal delivery.
platforms.notes: Career-preparation tool rather than a vacancy platform.

platforms.title: Workana
platforms.use_case: Remote consulting, IT, programming, data, DevOps, architecture and management projects.
platforms.notes: Useful for consulting and project-based income rather than senior permanent executive employment.

platforms.title: Ureed
platforms.use_case: Technology, AI, data, digital transformation and management consulting projects.
platforms.notes: Strong regional freelance platform; position yourself as a senior technology and transformation consultant.

platforms.title: Forasna
platforms.use_case: Egypt vacancies across multiple sectors and employer sizes.
platforms.notes: Broad Egyptian job board. Use management, IT, systems and project keywords to avoid unrelated frontline results.

platforms.title: Nafezly
platforms.use_case: Freelance software, architecture, business analysis, data and digital consulting projects.
platforms.notes: Better suited to project-based work and portfolio building than executive permanent roles.

platforms.title: Khamsat
platforms.use_case: Sell focused digital, technology advisory, architecture-review, dashboard and documentation services.
platforms.notes: Microservice marketplace; relevant mainly for small consulting packages and additional income.

platforms.title: Sabbar
platforms.use_case: Saudi full-time, part-time and flexible vacancies, including IT, project management and healthcare categories.
platforms.notes: Mostly retail, service and operational roles; filter carefully for IT, software and project-management positions.

platforms.title: Tars Jobs
platforms.use_case: Government, private-sector and general Saudi vacancy announcements.
platforms.notes: Vacancy-announcement aggregator. Verify every employer and application route before submitting personal data.

platforms.title: Taleek
platforms.use_case: Improve English and other languages for interviews and international opportunities.
platforms.notes: Career-support and language-learning tool, not a job platform.

platforms.title: PTway
platforms.use_case: Part-time, daily, contract and flexible roles including programming, operations and UX/UI.
platforms.notes: Primarily part-time and flexible work; senior executive relevance is limited.

platforms.title: Shiftat
platforms.use_case: Saudi vacancies and recruitment support across sectors and cities.
platforms.notes: Mainly recent-graduate and intermediate-experience recruitment; monitor only for technology leadership exceptions.

platforms.title: AS3A
platforms.use_case: Flexible, seasonal, shift-based and part-time employment.
platforms.notes: Strong flexible-work platform but limited alignment with senior enterprise-technology roles.

platforms.title: Marn
platforms.use_case: Hourly, seasonal, part-time and full-time staffing in retail, hospitality, logistics, healthcare and other sectors.
platforms.notes: Monitor only for IT management or technology-enabled operations roles.

platforms.title: Wardiyyat
platforms.use_case: Temporary and part-time shifts across retail, hospitality, logistics, events and other industries.
platforms.notes: Useful for flexible shift work, but not a primary source for senior technology leadership roles.

platforms.title: Part Time Platform
platforms.use_case: Historical part-time and flexible recruitment platform.
platforms.notes: The previously associated par-time.com domain appears inactive; use the LinkedIn presence only and recheck before relying on it.
